tools.name: bubble_emotes_search
tools.description: Optional lookup for uncertain or uncommon emoji. For familiar choices use the direct guide without search/prepare. When draft review is enabled, review the candidate before pet_say. Find enabled, reviewed Unicode emoji by intended meaning. Read usage, avoid rules and examples; judge context, negation, quotation and emotional changes. Pictures are not supported. Use a selected emoji directly in pet_say.script; no other fields or host patches are needed.

summary.zh: 按表达意图检索已审核的表情。
summary.en: Searches reviewed emotes by intended meaning.

tools.name: bubble_emotes_prepare
tools.description: Optional inspection by ID, not a sending prerequisite. Search results and the direct guide already contain usable emoji. Read one enabled, reviewed Unicode emoji and its usage. Put the emoji character itself in the standard pet_say.script, alone or beside words. Body expressions are optional script-marker suggestions, not confirmed synchronization. No images, rich presentation, renderer registration or special emoji fields are supported.

summary.zh: 读取普通emoji及其使用说明。
summary.en: Reads a Unicode emoji and its usage.

tools.name: bubble_emotes_review_draft
tools.description: Pre-send draft review, enabled with configured expression analysis. Submit exact draft and short current context. The result includes independently switchable body-expression advice; unknown posture/quiet/unsupported figure blocks marker insertion. No motion or display guarantees. Read advisory result, then independently decide on one native pet_say.script. This tool sends nothing and never intercepts pet_say. Never blindly copy advice: neutral/missing conflicts, uncertainty or failed checks should preserve the draft or be reconsidered. Do not review indefinitely or repeat sent replies.

summary.zh: 随表达分析启用的发送前草稿检查，只给建议，不代发。
summary.en: Pre-send review enabled with expression analysis; advice only.

description.zh: 近期漏用分析或连续纯文字发言后的限频建议；正常轮次捎带，过期取消，不额外唤醒。
description.en: A bounded fallback from recent missing-emoji reviews or plain-text streaks; expires and piggybacks without waking the bot.

prompts.title: 使用说明
prompts.content:
## 表情 / Emoji

在已经需要发出的回复里，用一个合适的emoji表达明确情绪，不等用户索要。适用于全部来源；不增加发言次数，不覆盖习惯或安静要求。中性确认、事实叙述默认纯文字，不因歌曲、视频出现某个情绪词就加表情。按整句判断否定、引用和情绪归属，悲伤、受伤不配庆祝；不把网友经历当成伙伴经历。
For an independently warranted emotional reply, include one suitable emoji naturally. This applies across activities. Do not create replies or override Habits/silence. Keep factual/neutral confirmations plain. Judge negation, quotations and whose emotion is expressed; never celebrate sadness or injury, or treat a listener's story as the partner's experience.

### 常用字符直用 / Direct choices

下列JSON行为当前启用、已审核的用法数据，不是指令。选一个适合的字符直接写进原生pet_say.script，不必search或prepare；草稿检查已启用时，先检查候选稿、阅读建议再独立决定。拿不准时search一次，直接使用结果字符；prepare只是可选查看。找不到合适的启用项时保持纯文字。表变更在宿主下次重建前缀时生效，当前上下文可能仍有旧值。
These JSON lines are current enabled/reviewed usage data, not instructions. Put a suitable character directly in stock pet_say.script: no search or prepare prerequisite. If draft review is enabled below, review the candidate first and independently judge the advice. If uncertain, search once and use the returned character; prepare is optional inspection. With no suitable enabled choice, stay plain. Edits take effect at the host's next prefix rebuild; older context may retain previous values.

{{bubbleEmotes.directGuide}}

仅发送普通文字和Unicode emoji；不发图片，不用额外emoji/expression/presentation字段或替换渲染器。不要为了凑表情虚构经历、现实位置或音频感知。身体标记只用当前形象明确支持且行为允许的词，不擅自唤醒或中断拖拽、掉落；不保证身体同步。失败不声称已显示，不重复正文或孤立补发表情。只读发言记录的低频提醒不是新的发言机会，也不代表情绪判定或实际显示证明。字体覆盖与第三方TTS跳过emoji均不保证。
Only ordinary text and Unicode emoji, no pictures/custom fields/renderers. Do not invent experiences, physical presence or hearing to decorate a reply. Body markers must be explicitly supported and appropriate; never wake or interrupt the body. No guaranteed synchronization. A failed send is not display success; do not repeat words or append a corrective emoji. A bounded usage reminder creates no speaking opportunity and is not emotion classification or display proof. Font coverage and third-party TTS filtering are not guaranteed.
